templates.name: Aurora
templates.about: Dark, loud and fast. A flowing aurora, slamming type, sparks and a 3D product reveal.

templates.name: Daylight
templates.about: Bright, clean and confident. Masked type, a product window that gets clicked, feature cards and one big number.

templates.name: Voltage
templates.about: One colour, black and giant type. Words that fill the screen, a before and after split, numbers that flip in.

templates.name: Terminal
templates.about: For developer tools. A typed command, a name that decodes from noise, a collapsing code diff and a speed comparison.

templates.name: Dispatch
templates.about: A release announced as a newspaper front page. The camera travels over the page; a rubber stamp lands at the end.

templates.name: Pocket
templates.about: For mobile apps. A phone spins in, three screens slide past, notifications drop on the beat. Bright and bouncy.

templates.name: Orbit
templates.about: For AI products. One continuous shot: a cloud of glowing particles becomes a sphere, an avatar, a ring, a sound wave.

templates.name: Arcade
templates.about: A milestone announced as an 8-bit game: the score rolls up, coins rain, achievements unlock. Chiptune soundtrack.

templates.name: Ticket
templates.about: A deal announced with a paper ticket: a split-flap board drops to the new price, perks get punched, scissors cut out the code.

templates.name: Trailer
templates.about: A teaser cut like a film trailer: black screen, metallic capitals, three words over blurred glimpses, the name reveal and the date.

templates.name: Blueprint
templates.about: An explainer drawn as a technical blueprint: lines that draw themselves, a three-step flow, an exploded view, measurements to scale.

templates.name: Plug
templates.about: An integration announcement: two tiles snap together, items travel between the two products, three setup steps. Flat colours and thick outlines.

templates.name: Marquee
templates.about: An event announced under a theatre marquee: chasing bulbs, neon that stutters on, a letter board for the date, spotlights on the agenda.

templates.name: Versus
templates.about: A comparison staged as a fighting game: a slammed VS, three rounds won one by one, a falling health bar and a K.O.

templates.name: Deskpad
templates.about: A hiring post on a cutting mat: sticky notes slapped down, role cards taped on, handwriting and marker strokes that draw themselves.

templates.name: Annual
templates.about: A year in review as a Swiss typographic poster: the year rolls in like an odometer, heavy numerals, a month-by-month line of milestones.

templates.name: Thread
templates.about: The product story told as a group chat: typing dots, bubbles that pop in, a result card with ticks, hearts flying up.

templates.name: Sunset
templates.about: Eighties synthwave: a neon grid rushing at the camera, a striped sun, chrome lettering and videotape glitches on every cut.

templates.name: Atlas
templates.about: An expansion announced on a dot map of the world: a radar sweep, a pin on the home city, routes arcing out to new ones, one big count.

templates.name: Chalk
templates.about: Pricing written on a café chalkboard: plans as a menu with dotted leaders, the recommended one circled, chalk dust falling as it writes.

templates.name: Receipt
templates.about: A savings story printed as a till receipt: the printer feeds it out line by line, the total gets highlighted, the camera pushes in.

templates.name: Panels
templates.about: A story told as a comic-book page: the camera goes from panel to panel, bursts and speed lines, then a banner snaps across the page.

templates.name: Jackpot
templates.about: A giveaway on a slot machine: three reels spin and stop on the prize, bulbs chase, coins burst out, then how to enter and when.

templates.name: Prism
templates.about: For analytics features: an isometric 3D world where real 3D columns rise from a glowing grid, glass tiles float in and the camera circles.
